ABOUT US

A Chitwan manufacturer, built for every water need in Nepal.

Government-certified plastic pipe and water storage manufacturing, supplying dealers from Bharatpur to Pokhara to Nepalgunj.

Jagadamba Plastic Industries has manufactured HDPE, PVC and CPVC pipe, fittings and water tanks in Bharatpur, Chitwan since 2063 B.S. — a milestone company of the Manakamana Group. Six product lines cover everything from underground drainage to rooftop water storage, each tested to national standard before it reaches a dealer shelf.

Homes & builders

Water tanks, PVC and CPVC fittings for household plumbing, hot-water lines and rooftop storage.

WATER TANK · PVC · CPVC FITTINGS

Farms & irrigation

Borewell casing and flexible HDPE pipe built for groundwater extraction and field irrigation.

BOREWELL PIPES · HDPE PIPE

Industry & infrastructure

Underground drainage systems built to handle structural load on larger municipal and industrial sites.

UG DRAINAGE PIPES
